request_id.description: Chosen by the sender. Goes in the email subject as PROOFBRIDGE {request_id} and in the body.

task_type.description: underlying_problem: Finds the underlying problem behind a planned solution, before it is built.; ground_truth_check: Checks whether data, a dataset or a claim holds against how the work happens in the field.; ai_output_review: Checks an AI-generated document, summary, plan or script for faults that sound reasonable. Choosing: If the material was made by an AI and the question is whether it holds against its source or the field, use ai_output_review. Use ground_truth_check for data or claims not produced by an AI. Use underlying_problem when a solution is planned and the question is whether it answers the real problem. When unsure, pick one and say so in context; Dennis re-routes.

question.description: What the principal wants to know, in one or two sentences.

artefact_urls.description: For reference only: links are not opened. Put the material in artefact_text.

artefact_text.description: The material itself, as text (up to about 50 000 characters).

context.description: Who it is for, who decided it, where it is used.

agent.description: Name of the agent sending on the principal's behalf, if any.

deadline.description: Date (UTC) at least 7 days after the request is sent (test phase) or after the payment is seen (paid tiers).

public_backlog_ok.description: true: task_type, status and dates may appear on the public backlog. The content never does.

tier.description: 0: test phase, no payment. 1 and 2: paid, not open during the test phase.

payment_txid.description: On-chain txid, or the Lightning payment hash once the Lightning rail is live.

payment_proof_bip322.description: Optional. BIP-322 signature over the SHA-256 of this request body, by a key that spent an input of the payment.

completion_reward_sats.description: Optional proposal; the reward is agreed in the tier 2 reply.
